subject.title: feat(sessions): let sessions_send register explicit state-change watchers

question: Should explicit watches reject ambiguous unqualified target session keys in v1, or should cursor identity be expanded to include the target agent?
rationale: The current persistent cursor key cannot distinguish same-key sessions owned by different agents, and choosing between a narrower accepted-target contract and a broader stored identity requires owner intent.

options.title: Reject ambiguous targets
options.body: Require agent-qualified target keys for explicit watches, matching the existing watcher-key restriction without changing the database schema.

options.title: Agent-qualify cursor identity
options.body: Add target agent identity to cursor storage, lookup, acknowledgement, cleanup, pruning, and compatibility coverage.

recommendation.title: Reject ambiguous targets
recommendation.body: Require agent-qualified target keys for explicit watches, matching the existing watcher-key restriction without changing the database schema.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and merged the underlying durable session-state design and authored this extension.
